bundle.shortDescription: Add captions to any video, transcribed on-device.
bundle.longDescription: CaptionSmith transcribes a video's audio locally with whisper.cpp, lets you edit and style the transcript, and exports burned-in captions or a subtitle sidecar file. Local-first: no accounts, no telemetry.
